description: Forge personal or governed enterprise knowledge into validated, traceable Obsidian Vault packages.

defaultPrompt: Guide me step by step to forge a complete project into resumable Obsidian Vault ZIP volumes. / 一步一步引導我把完整專案鍛造成可續作的 Obsidian Vault ZIP 分卷。
Continue my project forge from FORGE-CHECKPOINT.md and process only the next source batch. / 從 FORGE-CHECKPOINT.md 繼續，只處理下一批來源。
Classify and safely route this enterprise knowledge project before I provide source contents. / 在我提供來源內容前，先為這個企業知識專案分級並決定安全處理路徑。
interface.longDescription: EW Knowledge Forge provides two paths in one plugin. The personal forge converts bounded conversations and documents into validated, resumable Obsidian Vault ZIP volumes. Enterprise Secure Forge adds pre-upload P0-P3 classification, approved cloud/local routing, candidate-to-approved publication, governance registers, and an auditable Forge Manifest. The enterprise skill is a governance and packaging control, not endpoint DLP; content already supplied to an AI service is not protected retroactively. / EW Knowledge Forge 在同一外掛中提供兩條路徑：個人版將有限範圍的對話與文件鍛造成可續作、經驗證的 Obsidian Vault ZIP；企業安全版則增加上傳前 P0-P3 分級、核准的雲端或本地路由、候選到正式知識的發布閘門、治理清冊與可稽核 Forge Manifest。企業版 Skill 是治理與封裝控制，不是端點 DLP，也無法追溯保護已交給 AI 服務的內容。

name: ew-obsidian-knowledge-forge
